about: Free & low-cost safety and mobility programs for USC students. Researched 2026-11-14; USC transport details confirmed from transnet.usc.edu and dps.usc.edu. Every entry lists an official source; confidence='check' means sources disagreed or the current details weren't confirmed. Times are America/Los_Angeles.

programs.name: USC Lyft Rides ("Fryft"): free shared Lyft, University Park
programs.summary: Free Lyft rides for current USC students, faculty and staff when both pickup and drop-off are inside the UPC boundary (east of Normandie, south of Washington, west of Main, north of MLK). 7 PM–2 AM, seven days a week.

how.app: Lyft app → choose SHARED (payment shows “USC Lyft Rides”)

programs.tags: free lyft uber ride home night late safe ride car taxi campus zone
programs.caveats: You must pick the Shared ride type. Not covered: tips, cancellation fees, PrimeTime, scheduled rides, added stops, rides between campuses. On home football days it starts 5 hours after kickoff. Monthly benefit is capped.
tips: Pick “Shared”, not Standard, or you'll be charged.
Check that the fare quote says FREE before you confirm.

programs.name: Campus Cruiser: free evening safe ride
programs.summary: Free evening rides that start and end inside the Campus Cruiser boundary. Call to request a pickup.
programs.tags: free ride escort night shuttle van call pickup campus home late
programs.caveats: USC lists 6 PM–12 AM daily; older pages show other hours. Confirm before relying on it.

programs.name: DPS safety escort & blue-light phones
programs.summary: Call DPS or use any blue-light emergency phone to request an escort, report something suspicious, or get help. 24/7 communications center.
programs.tags: escort walk with me followed scared emergency police security blue light phone help walk home

programs.name: LiveSafe app (SafeWalk)
programs.summary: USC's official safety app: message or call DPS, report tips anonymously, and use SafeWalk so a friend can watch your walk in real time.
programs.tags: app safewalk share location friend watch walk report tip anonymous dps

programs.name: Security Ambassadors (yellow jackets)
programs.summary: Contracted, unarmed patrollers in bright yellow jackets posted on street corners in the neighborhoods around campus. Flag one down if you need help or feel unsafe.
programs.tags: yellow jacket patrol corner neighborhood off campus help walk night guard
programs.caveats: Posts and hours vary.

programs.name: Free bike & scooter registration
programs.summary: Register your bike, e-bike, scooter or skateboard with DPS (required on campus). The decal and record help DPS identify and return it if it's stolen or impounded.
programs.tags: bike stolen theft scooter skateboard e-bike register recover lock
programs.caveats: DPS recommends a U-lock; no free-lock giveaway was found this semester.

programs.name: Free Narcan & fentanyl test strips
programs.summary: Free naloxone (Narcan) nasal spray and fentanyl test strips at the Engemann and Eric Cohen Student Health Center front desks, at outreach events, and from the student-run NaloxoneSC. A free online training also gets you a twin pack.
programs.tags: narcan naloxone overdose opioid fentanyl test strips drugs party harm reduction
programs.caveats: One USC page said test strips were temporarily sold out.

programs.name: Metro U-Pass (unlimited bus & rail)
programs.summary: Unlimited LA Metro bus and rail for USC students, paid through a mandatory transportation fee (a student reported $67.50 for spring 2026).
programs.tags: bus train metro rail pass transit unlimited e line commute

programs.name: Campus Support & Intervention (crisis help)
programs.summary: Care coordination for distressing situations: critical-incident response, DPS incident follow-up, professor notifications and referrals. Also runs an emergency loan of up to $1,000 (repayable in 90 days).
programs.tags: crisis help unsafe housing emergency money loan support incident stalking harassment
programs.caveats: The loan must be repaid; it's not a grant. Free relocation isn't offered; Student Basic Needs helps with housing next steps.

programs.name: Metro free rides on Christmas Eve
programs.summary: Metro waives fares on all buses and trains from 4 AM Dec 24 to 3 AM Dec 25, a yearly tradition.
programs.tags: christmas holiday free bus train ride home party
programs.caveats: Confirm the 2026 announcement.

programs.name: Metro free rides on New Year's Eve
programs.summary: Fares are waived from 4 AM Dec 31 to 3 AM Jan 1: fare gates unlatched, buses don't collect. Last year's run was Dec 31, 2025.
programs.tags: new years eve nye holiday free bus train party drinking ride home
programs.caveats: Metro says it does this every year; confirm 2026 hours.

programs.name: AAA Tipsy Tow (free tow home if you've been drinking)
programs.summary: If you (or a friend) drove and have been drinking, call and say "I need a Tipsy Tow": a free one-way tow of the car and the driver home, up to 7 miles. Non-members can use it.
programs.tags: drunk drinking can't drive tow car home sober designated driver holiday
programs.caveats: Offered on select holidays only (historically NYE and July 4); no reservations; driver only. Confirm the 2026 window.

programs.name: LADOT free-ride days (DASH, Commuter Express, LAnow)
programs.summary: LADOT runs fare-free days. In 2026: Transit Equity Day (Feb 4) and Primary Election Day (June 2). Election days usually qualify.
programs.tags: free bus dash election vote transit equity day
programs.caveats: Dates are announced each time; only Feb 4 repeats yearly.

programs.name: Metro LIFE: 20 free rides a month
programs.summary: LA County residents on EBT, Medi-Cal or below the income limit get 90 days of free rides at sign-up, then 20 free rides every month on Metro, Metro Micro and many partner agencies. Can be combined with the college reduced fare.
programs.tags: can't afford bus fare low income free rides money student discount transit
programs.caveats: Income-based; check eligibility.

programs.name: Mobility Wallet: $150/month for transport (South LA pilot)
programs.summary: A prepaid card with $150 a month for transit, bike share, scooters and rideshare, for low-income residents of the South LA pilot area (10 Fwy to Florence, Crenshaw to Alameda), which includes the neighborhoods around USC.
programs.tags: money transport subsidy card rides south la low income lyft uber bus bike
programs.caveats: Enrollment happens in phases; Phase III was planned for 2026. Uses Metro LIFE eligibility.

programs.name: South Central Power Up: free e-bike loan
programs.summary: Long-term e-bike loans at no cost for South LA participants. Participants can also get up to $1,800 toward buying a bike, e-bike or scooter through the 2026 Bike Wallet pilot.
programs.tags: free e-bike electric bike loan scooter commute south la
programs.caveats: Limited slots; the Bike Wallet credit is for existing participants.

programs.name: Metro Bike Share reduced fare ($5 / 30 days)
programs.summary: With a Reduced Fare TAP card (college students qualify), a 30-day bike share pass is $5 and a year is $50.
programs.tags: bike share cheap bike ride rent bicycle student discount
programs.caveats: Prices from Metro's TAP site; confirm on the Bike Share site.

programs.name: DASH buses free with student reduced fare
programs.summary: Students with a Metro Student Reduced Fare TAP or GoPass ride LADOT DASH free. Otherwise $0.50.
programs.tags: dash bus free student local shuttle

programs.name: Metro Transit Watch app (text security 24/7)
programs.summary: On a bus or train and something's wrong? Text or call Metro security 24/7 in the app, share photos or video, or report harassment anonymously. Available in 14 languages.
programs.tags: harassment bus train metro unsafe report text security anonymous followed

programs.name: Report a broken streetlight
programs.provider: City of LA, Bureau of Street Lighting
programs.summary: Dark block on your walk home? Report the outage through MyLA311 or the Bureau of Street Lighting so it gets fixed. Outages hit a record 5,200 requests in Jan 2025.
programs.tags: streetlight light out dark street report 311 walk night
programs.caveats: Repairs can take months.

programs.name: Drink-spiking test kits & lids at bars (CA law)
programs.summary: California bars and nightclubs (Type 48 licenses) must keep drink-spiking test kits and offer drink lids, and post a 'Don't get roofied!' sign. AB 1982 (2026) made it permanent. Just ask a staff member.
programs.tags: bar club drink spiked roofie test kit lid party nightlife drugged
programs.caveats: The law doesn't clearly require kits to be free; bars may charge.

programs.name: Safe at Home: free confidential address
programs.summary: Survivors of domestic violence, stalking, sexual assault or trafficking get a free substitute address and mail forwarding, so you can sign a lease or register with school without revealing where you live.
programs.tags: stalking stalker hide address survivor domestic violence privacy lease mail
programs.caveats: Enrollment goes through a certified enrolling agency.

programs.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
programs.summary: Free, confidential 24/7 support by call or text. In LA County, calls go to a local crisis center.
programs.tags: crisis mental health suicide panic anxiety talk text support

programs.name: Uber Women Preferences
programs.summary: Women riders can ask to be matched with women drivers (US-wide since March 2026). Expect longer waits when few are nearby.
programs.tags: women driver female rideshare uber safe ride preference
programs.caveats: Matching depends on driver availability.

programs.name: Share My Trip / RideCheck (Uber & Lyft)
programs.summary: Share a live trip link with a friend; Uber RideCheck and Lyft Smart Trip Check-In flag long stops or route changes; in-app emergency button.

how.app: In the ride screen: Share trip / Safety toolkit

programs.tags: share trip location friend rideshare uber lyft emergency button route

programs.name: Apple Check In / Kitestring (auto check-in)
programs.summary: Tell a friend when you expect to be home; if you don't arrive or reply in time, they get your location automatically. Apple Check In is built into iMessage (iOS 17+); Kitestring works by text on any phone.
programs.tags: check in arrive home friend alert timer walk alone eta

programs.name: USC Lyft Rides: Health Sciences Campus (incl. Union Station)
programs.summary: Free shared Lyft rides inside the HSC boundary and to/from Union Station, 5 PM–2 AM, Monday–Friday.

how.app: Lyft app → Shared (requires the HSC Lyft Invite form)

programs.tags: hsc health sciences keck free lyft union station night ride
programs.caveats: Rides between UPC and HSC are not covered. HSC access needs the Lyft Invite form.

programs.name: Free LAX shuttle for Thanksgiving (reserve first)

deadlines.label: Reserve a seat for the free Thanksgiving LAX shuttle

programs.summary: Shuttles to LAX leave Widney Alumni House every hour 8 AM–5 PM on Nov 24–25, 2026. Seats are limited and first come, first served. Reserve by 11:59 PM Nov 20.
programs.tags: lax airport flight thanksgiving break home holiday shuttle free bus
programs.caveats: The 2026 page doesn't state the price; USC's LAX break shuttles were free in 2023 and 2024. Winter-break dates are announced later.

programs.name: USC shuttle: UPC ↔ Union Station (weekdays)
programs.summary: USC-run shuttle from the Jefferson bus turnout (just east of Hoover) to Union Station Berth #6, 37 departures 7:00 AM–10:05 PM on weekdays. Union Station connects to Metrolink, Amtrak and the FlyAway bus to LAX.
programs.tags: union station shuttle bus metrolink amtrak train downtown commute free intercampus
programs.caveats: The route page doesn't list a fare; it's a USC service for the USC community.

programs.name: USC weekend shuttle: UPC · HSC · Union Station
programs.summary: A weekend loop between University Park (Jefferson at Hoover), the Health Sciences Campus (Eastlake at Biggy) and Union Station, 8:30 AM–4:40 PM Saturdays and Sundays.
programs.tags: weekend shuttle union station hsc health sciences free bus saturday sunday
programs.caveats: No service on home football gamedays, Nov 28–29 (Thanksgiving), or during summer and winter break.

programs.name: Zipcar: free membership your first year
programs.summary: Join Zipcar free for your first year ($35/yr after). Discounted hourly rates for students 18+; gas, insurance and maintenance included. Handy for a late grocery run or a group trip instead of walking far at night.
programs.tags: car rent drive zipcar grocery trip night group cheap
